verdict.rationale: Agents can author infrastructure changes: the official MCP server lets AI assistants such as Claude Code and Cursor generate infrastructure code, and Neo accepts plain-English requests. `pulumi preview` shows proposed updates without changing the stack, and the Automation API runs Pulumi programs programmatically without the CLI, which covers the headless plan step. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented approval gate for agent-proposed diffs (only implied by Neo's 'enterprise controls' and PR comment integrations), detail on diff output format, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.
